criteria.reason: verify-design-comparison SKILL.md has name, description, when_to_use and allowed-tools frontmatter, a When it applies section and an Inputs table.
verify-flow-as-built SKILL.md has the four frontmatter keys, a When it applies section and an Inputs table.
verify-data-fidelity SKILL.md has the four frontmatter keys, a When it applies section and an Inputs table.

No skill ships a script (ls shows only SKILL.md and __tests__), but only verify-data-fidelity says the agent writes any needed script itself at run time; verify-design-comparison (whose crop/diff/stitch step most needs one) and verify-flow-as-built carry no such line. The criterion requires each of the three to say it.

Exemplar shows per-frame Design/Build/Diff/Overlay with a fade slider; the skill's page spec (read in FS-7's artifact) requires one card per frame with four panels Design | Build @commit | Diff "N% differs" | Overlay with a Design-Build fade slider.
Rubric requires opening every stitched image, lists the six statuses, and states the diff % never sets the status; page spec requires a one-sentence verdict and notes.

Page spec requires cross-cutting problems once, a diff legend, a status filter bar, a jump strip, the navigation route per frame and uncaptured cards with their reason; each has a counterpart in the exemplar.
Inputs table names bezel crop box, frame size, status-bar height, capture commands, evidence folders, data caveat and page title as per-project inputs; grep found no hard-coded exemplar values.
All three skills forbid writing a credential value into the page, manifests, verdicts and the agent's claim/return, recording only where it lives.
Flow skill derives as-built edges from code first, walks each designed journey, and calls out extra/missing edges, one criterion per journey.
Data skill captures rendered rows and a read-only fetch of the source per view and writes a row table with a per-row verdict.
